issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into paths without URL quoting, so '/', '?', and '#' in IDs misroute requests or alter the URL.
httpx transport and timeout exceptions are not retried or wrapped in LumenAPIError, leaking raw client exceptions to callers.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and bypasses backoff_cap, allowing invalid HTTP-date headers to be ignored and huge sleeps to be honored.
backoff_base and backoff_cap are not validated, so negative or inconsistent values can produce invalid sleep durations.
BatchItemResult.from_dict does not validate status or enforce task/error consistency, allowing invalid API results into typed models.
ReviewResult.from_dict does not validate verdict despite the public Verdict literal type.
Package ships inline type hints but no lumen/py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may not treat it as typed.
